selector.rationale: The presence of hyperkeratosis, distinct vacuolization in the granular and upper spinous layers, and bullae formation within the epidermis, along with a heterozygous variation c.482T>C (p. L161P) in KRT1, supports Epidermolytic Hyperkeratosis as the most likely diagnosis.

rejected.label: Bullous Congenital Ichthyosiform Erythroderma
rejected.why: Although it shares some similar symptoms, the specific genetic variation and histopathological findings point more strongly towards Epidermolytic Hyperkeratosis.
